name: FMA Brotherhood clean adventure
summary: Crisp late-2000s digital TV action-adventure: clean confident lines, bold readable cel shading, saturated costumes against brick-and-steel European industrial towns lit by alchemy flashes.

traits.line: Clean, medium-weight black lines with some taper; firm shapes; mechanical prosthetics drawn in crisp detail (Hiroki Kanno designs).
traits.shading: Hard two-tone cel shadows with a separate highlight tone on metal; little gradient; switches to chibi gag faces.
traits.palette: Saturated, readable colours: red coat, blue military uniforms, gold hair, steel grey; warm sandy desert tones and brick browns.
traits.lighting: Bright clear daylight; blue-white and red transmutation flashes; darker scenes for villains.
traits.faces: Shonen designs: medium-large eyes with defined irises, angular jaws, distinctive hair silhouettes; caricature gag faces.
traits.backgrounds: Painted early-20th-century European towns, military headquarters, desert ruins and laboratories with detailed brickwork.
traits.camera: Dynamic action layouts, crisp impact frames, wide establishing shots of towns.

style_words: Late-2000s digital TV action-adventure animation: clean medium-weight black lines, hard two-tone cel shadows with crisp metal highlights, saturated readable reds, military blues and gold against brick-brown and sandy European industrial towns, bright clear daylight and blue-white transmutation flashes, clean finish, as in Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood (2009).
avoid: thick Wit-style outlines and dark grading

krea2.style: Late-2000s digital TV action-adventure animation, as in Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood: clean medium-weight black lines with slight taper, hard two-tone cel shadows with crisp metal highlights, saturated readable reds, military blues and gold against brick browns and sandy tones, bright, clearly readable light, smooth clean flat colour surfaces.
krea2.recap: Rendered throughout as late-2000s digital TV anime with clean black lines and hard two-tone cel shadows.

flux3_klein.style: Late-2000s digital TV anime in the register of Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood: clean, medium-weight black lines with some taper and firm shapes, hard two-tone cel shadows with little gradient, a separate crisp highlight tone on metal, medium-large eyes with defined irises and angular jaws, saturated readable colour fills, smooth flat cel paint, painted backgrounds with detailed brickwork and stone, a clean digital finish with little grain.
flux3_klein.recap: Brick brown and sandy ochre fill the walls, the stone and the ground, clear blue fills the sky, steel grey sits in the shadow fills, gold appears only in metal highlights and the flames, and every garment keeps its own stated colour.

qwen_image_2_1.style: The image is a late-2000s digital TV animation frame in a signature Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood style, with clean medium-weight black lines with slight taper, flat, unmodulated colour fills and hard-edged shadow shapes in two tones, crisp separate highlight tones on metal, detailed painted backgrounds and a clean, smooth digital finish, depicting a scene from a Gothic Victorian novel in a palette of saturated readable reds, military blues, gold and steel grey, with brick browns and warm sandy tones.
qwen_image_2_1.recap: The overall composition lays out its forms in a clear, dynamic arrangement of crisp readable shapes, with an energetic adventure mood, keeps to a palette of saturated readable reds, military blues, gold and steel grey, with brick browns and warm sandy tones, and reads throughout as a late-2000s digital TV animation frame in a signature Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood style, with clean medium-weight black lines with slight taper, flat, unmodulated colour fills and hard-edged shadow shapes in two tones, crisp separate highlight tones on metal, detailed painted backgrounds and a clean, smooth digital finish.
